DMSS and ASPCS scan the 3D point cloud terrain data and correct the GPS-RTK reference points to create the BIM and digital twin model. The remote operator controls the equipment fleet but does not operate it directly. When the battery SoC of U-EEX Unit 1 reaches 15%, BSS_T replaces the battery pack within 5 min. AI_ICP optimizes the swap sequence so that two or more units do not leave work at the same time. When the PHM module of AI_ICP detects an anomaly sign in the pressure pattern of the hydraulic system of U-EDT Unit 7, the maintenance team, on this basis, performs preventive maintenance on the hydraulic module of U-EDT Unit 7 within 1 h. AI_ICP recalculates the routes to bypass the subsidence zones. After the site supervisor completes the safety inspection, the remote supervisor resumes construction in Level 3, and when about 30 min of normal operation is confirmed, switches back to Level 4.
